title: Capability taxonomy is documented in the rcf-lite docs
description: User story under REQ-171. a reader of the rcf-lite docs deciding whether to adopt the convention the capability:<slug> convention, the initial taxonomy and the rule for adding a new capability documented alongside the rest of the rcf-lite docs
asA: a reader of the rcf-lite docs deciding whether to adopt the convention
iWant: the capability:<slug> convention, the initial taxonomy and the rule for adding a new capability documented alongside the rest of the rcf-lite docs
soThat: a new capability is added deliberately rather than by drift, and a reader can look up what each slug means

acceptanceCriteria.description: packages/rcf-lite/docs contains a capability tags section listing every slug in the initial taxonomy with a one-line meaning, plus the rule for adding a new capability (single-word verb or noun, kebab-case, must map to a product surface). The section is linked from docs/README.md so it is reachable from the docs entry point.
